title: Preview of the studio landing page
changes: A new landing page for the Katsumii studio, built around an interactive galaxy where every app is its own star system, is available as an unlisted preview
The preview has its own navigation and footer, in English, German and Traditional Chinese

title: Pages are readable for search engines and AI assistants
changes: Every page now ships with its full text, so search engines and AI assistants can read it without running any scripts
Page titles and descriptions are rewritten in English, German and Traditional Chinese to say plainly what each page covers
Search results can now show the license options and the FAQ answers
Addresses consistently end in a slash, the sitemap carries real update dates, and unknown addresses show a proper 404 page

title: The ginkgo leaf gets a sharper edge
changes: The logo now renders from a sharper master file — crisper edges in the navigation bar, the closing call to action, the preview notice and the browser tab, same design as before

title: The bonsai gives way to a ginkgo leaf
changes: Katsumii has a new logo — a gold and teal ginkgo leaf where the low-poly bonsai used to stand — in the navigation bar, the closing call to action and the preview notice
The browser tab carries the new mark too, so pinned tabs and bookmarks match the site

title: The security.txt file is reachable again
changes: /.well-known/security.txt now loads on the live site — the deployment step was silently dropping it, so security researchers looking for it found nothing

title: A place to report a security problem
changes: A new Security page explains how to report a vulnerability in Katsumii, how quickly you hear back, and what falls inside and outside our scope
The page is linked from the footer of every page and is available in all site languages
Security researchers who look for the standard /.well-known/security.txt file now find one, pointing at the same contact address

title: The whole site now speaks your language
changes: Every page is translated end to end — landing page, the three trading mode pages, analytics, customization, workflow, local & offline, welcome, the 404 page and the preview notice no longer fall back to English
A language switch now sits in the navigation bar of every page, so you can change language without editing the address
Traditional Chinese moved from /tw/ to /zht/; old /tw/ links land on the same page instead of a dead end
Spanish is on hold for now — Spanish addresses open the English page rather than a 404
In light mode every page uses the same bright background as the landing page; the subpages had picked up a grey cast

title: The middle licence is called Lite, and the nav stays put
changes: The middle licence is named Lite instead of Light — on the pricing cards, in the comparison table, in the FAQ and in all four languages
Switching between light and dark no longer hides the navigation bar while the glitch effect runs
On a first visit the app now picks its theme by time of day, the same rule the page already applied before it loaded — no more switch a moment after opening

title: The headline promises honesty instead of a memory
changes: The rotating word in the landing headline now reads "Trade with honesty" where it used to read "Trade with a memory" — the old phrasing never quite worked in either half of the headline

title: A fact-check across every page, and a FAQ that answers more
changes: Broker sync is now described the way it works: you press Sync now and Katsumii pulls your fills — nothing ever runs in the background
Landing, pricing, features and the FAQ now name the edition a feature belongs to, so imports, broker sync, HTML reports and automatic backups no longer read as if every licence included them
The FAQ answers four questions it was missing — trying the app for free, updates after buying, how many devices one licence covers, and what to do if your data is lost
Its categories went from nine to five, so picking one in the sidebar leads to a real list instead of a single question
The four discipline pages lost a dozen repeated legal side-notes; the ones that carried real information moved into the disclaimer, and their status labels now use one consistent vocabulary

Funded is discipline 01 everywhere — the feature hub had numbered it differently from the landing page, the navigation and the pages themselves — and its Journaling and Imports cards finally link to their detail page
Demo, Light and Professional are described by what they actually contain, down to the five trades the free Demo allows
The sitemap no longer stamps all 68 URLs with the build date, so search engines can see when a page genuinely changed

title: Screenshots open full screen, with a 100% zoom
changes: Every product screenshot on the site is now clickable — it opens full screen, and a second click blows it up to 100% so you can read the actual numbers, dragging to move around
The viewer works from the keyboard as well: tab to a screenshot, Enter to open it, Escape to close
The enlarged view always matches what you clicked, including the current theme and whichever variant a page is showing

title: A phone-first pass over navigation, pricing and the background
changes: The mobile menu now groups the feature pages the same way the desktop menu does — two collapsible sections, one open at a time
Pricing comparison on phones shows one plan at a time with a picker instead of a table you have to scroll sideways
Legal pages get a collapsible table of contents on phones instead of a long list above the text
The particle background now thins out behind headlines and body copy instead of being covered by a soft patch, so no edge shows at any width
Fewer particles on narrow screens, where the old count read far too dense
The manual's chapter button steps out of the way over the footer and the cookie banner
Content keeps clear of notches and rounded corners in landscape

title: Every page on the V6 design, and a working social preview
changes: Local & offline, Welcome and the 404 page rebuilt in the V6 design — the last three pages still running the old shell
Local & offline rewritten: where the data sits, what actually touches the network, and how backups work
Add a real Open Graph image — link previews in chat apps and social networks were pointing at a file that no longer existed
Customization and Workflow are now pre-rendered and listed in the sitemap; direct links to them no longer take a detour
Retire the /v2–/v5 design prototypes and the entire legacy page shell that came with them
Add the Instagram profile to the footer and the contact page
Add Local & offline to the Features menu and the mobile navigation
Contact form keeps your message and offers to copy it, in case the mail client never opened
Replace the dashboard hero screenshot on the landing, Features and Workflow pages
Retire the /local-first URL in favour of /local-offline and drop the dead translation data behind it (~30% smaller page bundle)

title: Re-export layout and theme screenshots
changes: Re-run the screenshot optimizer to refresh dashboard layout and snow theme WebP exports

title: Unified page rhythm and full-viewport section bands
changes: Introduce a shared --v6-container width so subpages read at the same rhythm as the home story pin
Analytics & Reviews, Features and Workflow: sections snap as full-viewport bands while scrolling (off on small screens and with reduced motion)
Workflow: replace the pinned tool-screenshot scroller with an accessible tabbed showcase (keyboard-navigable, ARIA tabs)
Features: modules grid reflows from 2 to 4 columns to fit within one band
Customization: rename light theme presets 'Paper' → 'Soft' and 'Snow' → 'Whiteout'
Re-export theme comparison screenshots

title: Real product screenshots across the site
changes: Replace every marketing image with real product screenshots, served as theme-aware WebP
Add scripts/optimize-screenshots.mjs — resizes and re-encodes all screenshots (~94% smaller), run via npm run screenshots
Customization: interactive layout switches (density, sidebars) that drive the screenshot, with idle prefetch of the variants
Customization: theme comparison frame showing three dark tones / two light papers at once, plus its own light/dark preview toggle
Move the 'Numbers, your way' section from Customization to Analytics & Reviews
Workflow: pinned scroll-through of the tools, report and backup screens
Add a version number to the footer and start maintaining this changelog

title: Add bug report page
changes: Add /bugreport route with Tally form embed (placeholder ID, to be replaced once form is created)
Add 'Report a Bug' link in footer Company section across all locales
Add full translations for bug report page (EN, DE, ES, ZH)
Tally embed.js is loaded dynamically on the bug report page only
Direct email fallback to bugs@katsumii.com shown below the form
